title: egress-decision-request
description: Metadata-only input to the OMES AI data-classification and model-egress policy evaluator (issue #214, ADR-0029, docs/ai-data-privacy-and-model-security.md). This shape MUST NEVER carry prompt text, response text, embeddings, retrieved documents, or a real credential/secret value - only bounded classification/destination/posture metadata used to reach a deterministic allow/deny/approval_required decision. `contains_authentication_material` is a caller-asserted boolean flag (never the material itself); it is intentionally not named with a banned secret-like substring so it can hold a plain boolean rather than being forced through the secret_ref shape.

policy_version.description: The egress-policy contract version this request was authored against. An evaluator that does not recognize this version must fail closed (deny) rather than guess at semantics.

classification.description: Data classification of the content that would be sent, per docs/ai-data-privacy-and-model-security.md section 4. Classification is about content/processing risk, not the filename or storage location.

destination.description: The model-destination class the content would be sent to, per docs/ai-data-privacy-and-model-security.md section 5.

purpose.description: A short, closed label for why model processing is requested (e.g. code_generation, reasoning_assist, summarization). Free-form prose describing the actual content is out of scope - this is a label, not a prompt.

tenant_id.description: Optional tenant scope for a multi-tenant caller (e.g. Control Center). Metadata only.

resource_scope.description: Optional resource scope within the tenant. Metadata only.

provider_posture.description: The pre-assessed posture of the destination provider/endpoint. `status` must be resolved to approved/not_approved for any non-local_only destination; `unknown` (or an absent object) fails closed.

provider_id.description: An opaque provider/profile identifier - never a credential.

contains_authentication_material.description: True if the content the caller wants to send includes credentials, API tokens, private keys, or other authentication/secret material. This flag is caller-asserted; the evaluator never inspects content to derive it. Only an explicit `false` is treated as 'no authentication material' - the evaluator treats any other value as `true` (fail closed).

sanitization_evidence.description: Evidence that application-owned sanitization/minimization occurred, referenced by identifier only - never the sanitized content itself.

provider_assurance.description: Provider-assurance evidence for the destination provider (issue #237, threat AI-07): the 10-item due-diligence checklist from docs/ai-data-privacy-and-model-security.md section 5, recorded as bounded verification statuses plus opaque, non-secret evidence references only - never a raw provider response or contract text. The evaluator (lib/omes/py/privacy/egress_policy.py) requires this object, with every item other than `private_networking_zero_retention_options` at status `verified`, before it will approve (allow/approval_required) a `cloud_sanitized` destination; a missing or incomplete record fails closed to `deny`. This shape mirrors contracts/ai-egress/v1/provider-assurance-evidence.schema.json - duplicated rather than `$ref`'d because this validator subset does not support `$ref` - and the two must be kept in sync by hand.

provider_id.description: An opaque provider/profile identifier - never a credential. Must match the corresponding `provider_posture.provider_id`.
